channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranian tankers exit US blockade zone before talks to end war
item.description: As US, Iran prepare to sign MoU and start more talks, TankerTrackers monitor says Iran exports first oil in two months.

item.title: Oil prices continue slide amid hopes for peace, opening of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Brent crude drops to lowest price since early March, before signing of framework deal to end US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Iran war day 110: Tehran says Israeli attacks on Lebanon threaten US deal
item.description: Iran warns of a 'harsh response' as Lebanon attacks test the US deal and strain Trump-Netanyahu ties.

item.title: Russian drone strikes residential building in Ukraine
item.description: A suspected Russian drone attack on a residential building in Ukraine has injured at least seven people.

item.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
item.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

item.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
item.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

item.title: The bikers battling extreme heat and armed conflict to smuggle Iranian fuel to Pakistan
item.description: It's so hot the fuel can catch fire - the bikers tell the BBC they must live with the risk of injury and death.

item.title: Tehran selling deal with US as victory – but for Iranians it was necessity
item.description: For many Iranians, the question is not whether the deal means victory, but whether it lowers prices and reduces fear of another war.

item.title: Iranian-Americans protest against Iran team at World Cup
item.description: The BBC’s Shaimaa Khalil was outside the Iran v New Zealand opening round match as protesters called for an end to Tehran’s clerical regime.
